title: The Standing beside the Shy Singer
youtube_title: The Standing beside the Shy Singer | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Trying the smallest brave step still counts.
summary: At a bakery counter facing the street, Uma feels shy about a place beside a singer who needed one more voice nearby. Instead of pretending not to care, Uma tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while the ferryman stays kind and does not push for a show.
